what: which parts of each reference design the photo set lets a careful solver locate; the surface items use only seen samples, the hole and flat-face items only gradable features

sampling.seed: strutgrade.detenv.seed_for(cfg, 'reference', design key); query samples seed + 1
sampling.use: dense bits mark the reference's dense samples (the distance targets); query bits mark its query samples (seed + 1; the reference -> submission direction measures from them)

rules.visible: in the frame (2 px margin), facing the camera with incidence <= 75 deg, not behind the z-buffer surface (exact rasterisation of the whole scene at 2016 x 1512, all hardware in place)
rules.seen: (a) visible in >= 2 photos whose view directions (in the part's own frame; the two parts of a pair pool their photos) are >= 25 deg apart, or (b) visible in one photo >= 45 deg off its normal with >= 60 % of its flat face's boundary visible in that photo; and r_n <= 2 L (r_n = min over photos of p / sin(theta) and over pairs of max(p_i, p_j) / sin(beta); L = 0.040 mm small parts, 0.067 mm large parts)
rules.plane_gradable: >= 60 % of its dense samples seen and >= 60 % of its boundary length visible in the photos that see it
rules.hole_step: mouth = an open end (winding-number probes); position gradable: >= 2 photos with the mouth facing (<= 80 deg), >= 15 px across and >= 25 % of its rim marked (wall or face side visible, or the insert / screw in it), >= 1 photo with >= 50 % marked; radius gradable: the same with the rim itself (nothing in the hole at the mouth) >= 50 % visible in >= 1 photo
rules.functional: the item's assumed method has >= 2 photos >= 25 deg apart showing each of its point groups (>= 10 % and >= 100 points)
